# Data absent
- `g1000_eur.bim`: SNP reference data for the European population, created using Phase 3 of the 1000 Genomes Project, and also on hg19. Downloaded from https://cncr.nl/research/magma/ on 16 March, 2025.
- `NCBI37.3.gene.loc`: NCBI gene locations for the hg19 assembly. Downloaded from https://cncr.nl/research/magma/ on 16 March, 2025.
